statement.p: In the past few seasons basketball games, Kandace attempted 460 free throws, and made 230 of them. What percent of free throws did Kandace make?
Kandace made of free throws in the past few seasons.

solution.p: This problem can be boiled down to this question: 230 is what percent of 460? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem.
Assume 230 is x\% of 460, so x out of 100 corresponds to 230 out of 460.
We will write and solve the proportion:
Kandace made 50\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem.
This translation from English to may should help you remember the percentage formula.
Assume 230 is x (as a percent) of 460. We have:
Kandace made 50\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
In the sentence 230 is what percent of 460,

li.p: 460 is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{rate} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{base}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
Kandace made 50\% of free throws in the past few seasons.
